QuestInfo.name: Porchay's Request 1
QuestInfo.0: Porchay says that monsters have been showing up on Florina Beach and causing trouble lately.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092013##k asks you to eliminate the Lorangs on Florina Beach. At the very least, you should help keep the Nautilus safe.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated some Lorangs, but there are so many of them. Does it ever end?

0.0: I don't understand how the monster population of Florina shot up so fast. Is it something in the water? Are all the monsters here on vacation?
0.1: I saw you taking down those Lorangs before, #h0#. I believe you can save Florina Beach from the pinchy crisis that faces us.
0.2: You can do this, right, #h0#? You have a high tolerance for pinching, don't you?

yes.0: I knew you would accept my request, #h0#. I knew, because you are awesome.
yes.1: Right then. Can you put a hurt on the #b#o3230102##k population? I think, if we want severe pinching incidents to go down, we need to take out at least #r50#k of them. You can manage that, right?

no.0: Remember, this is for the citizens. They didn't ask for this.

1.0: I had no idea you could do that so fast. You should work for a seafood restaurant!

mob.0: Florina Beach is still crawling with #b#o3230102#s#k. I got pinched just a few minutes ago, and wow-WEE, it hurts! Eliminate #r50#k of those things, pronto!
